label: Bible Study
prompt: A new _____ I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
verse: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
note: Given at the Last Supper — 'new' because of the measure: as I have loved you.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand _____, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
verse: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
note: Sea in front, Pharaoh's chariots behind — and Moses's battle plan is 'stand still.' It worked.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven _____, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:
verse: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:
note: Pharaoh retells his dream to Joseph: seven fat 'kine' — old English for cows — soon to be eaten by seven lean ones.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have _____, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
verse: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
note: John cites this at the cross after the soldier's spear: 'They shall look on him whom they pierced.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and _____.
verse: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
note: Work it out with fear and 'trembling' — and the very next verse says it is God who works in you.
